notes.body:
added 245 commits
  • 4c76ac39...100fe4e9 - 244 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • a0229074 - Extcap: Add dissector for extcap_example.py
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/7694/diffs?diff_id=457810056&start_sha=4c76ac3964f5b7aea70d97ff97bcc65b927b493c)
Does this dissector fit as a Lua plugin example?
Could definitely be made into one. This is mainly a storage for me, based on work I've done for a few SF presentations.
If still relevant feel free to rebase and reopen
